**Must-Fix 1 — per-round reference timestamp certified the inter-round gaps CLEAN.** v4 keyed both legs on the NEWEST `planner-dispatch` breadcrumb. The breadcrumb is posted per round (`round=<k>`), so the reference re-armed on every Phase 3 re-spawn and covered only the per-round tails. A parent corrected while the plan sat in critic review — the fleet's routine correction channel — fell in the gap between v(K-1)'s persist and round K's spawn: round K inherits the stale text without re-reading, `body_commit < DRAFT_START_K`, verdict CLEAN. The Goal's window is fact-check -> persist and spans those gaps, so v4 would have stamped CLEAN over most of the window the gate exists to watch. Fix: both legs pin to the campaign's EARLIEST planner spawn (helper captures DRAFT_START once at round 1, never refreshes; c75 fallback 1 becomes OLDEST-breadcrumb-older-than-plan-mtime), plus a lost-shell-var clause mirroring the Goal-currency gate's missing-snapshot posture — re-derive from the oldest breadcrumb rather than passing an empty --since-unix, which would degrade to UNKNOWN/exit 0 exactly when the gate matters most. Regression test added as success criterion 6.

**Must-Fix 2 — the URL-adjacency filter dropped genuine citations.** v4's `[/\w.-]` drop class kills every non-first member of the `#884/#1045/#1134` lineage-list idiom. Critic measured 25 random real plan files: 20 of 206 distinct cited ids (10%, affecting 11/25 plans) appear ONLY in filtered positions — this plan's own section 3.2 included. That is a false NEGATIVE on the exact surface the gate watches, printing `CLEAN checked=N` while never probing the corrected parent, and it contradicted the plan's own stated over-inclusion preference. Fix: drop class narrowed to `\w` only (still kills `issues#123` / `file.md#123`); `test_slash_separated_refs_extracted` added.
